records.text: Hemet Nesingwary is an old, seasoned dwarf hunter who runs a safari in Nagrand. records.text: An Allerian Defender on duty, this guard talks with fellow defenders about a wanted poster offering gold for killing bonelashers. The conversation moves between curiosity about the bounty, concern about the dangerous Bone Wastes and its disease-carrying creatures, and the prospect of earning extra money after a shift. The defenders also complain that adventurers are paid for work they already do, revealing a wry sense of unfairness alongside their caution.
